title: FRACTAL: A Self-Similar Multi-Agent Orchestration Architecture with Formal Communication, Convergence, and Depth Bounds
abstract: arXiv:2610.22561v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present FRACTAL, a self-similar multi-agent architecture for recursive goal decomposition, in which the same five-component organizational pattern -- Orchestrator, Ensemble, Knowledge Ledger, Decision Maker, Meta-Observer -- recurs at every level of a decomposition tree. We make four formal contributions: (1) a communication bound showing intra-node cost is linear in ensemble size and round count (O(kr)) under a two-phase blind-proposal/stress-test protocol, versus quadratic cost for free-form debate, with an explicit, stated assumption on fixed evaluator count; (2) a two-mode orchestration criterion separating generative and evaluative phases via a measurable diversity-saturation threshold; (3) a supermajority convergence guarantee with explicit probability bounds at stated agreement levels, and a formal depth bound under an operationalized goal-complexity measure; (4) a Bayesian inter-layer escalation mechanism unifying hysteresis a

translated_title: FRACTAL：一种具有形式化通信、收敛与深度界的自相似多智能体编排架构
translated_abstract: 我们提出了FRACTAL，一种用于递归目标分解的自相似多智能体架构，其中相同的五组件组织模式——编排器、集成体、知识账本、决策者与元观察者——在分解树的每一层递归出现。我们做出了四项形式化贡献：(1) 一个通信上界，证明在两阶段盲提案/压力测试协议下，节点内成本关于集成规模与轮次数为线性，而自由形式辩论的成本为二次方，并对固定的评估者数量作出了明确假设；(2) 一个双模式编排准则，通过可测量的多样性饱和阈值将生成阶段与评估阶段分离；(3) 一个超多数收敛保证，在给定共识水平下具有明确的概率界，以及在可操作化的目标复杂度度量下的形式化深度上界；(4) 一个贝叶斯层间升级机制，统一了迟滞……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出FRACTAL自相似多智能体架构，以统一的五组件模式递归分解目标，并形式化证明了线性通信成本界、双模式编排准则、超多数收敛概率界与目标深度上界，辅以贝叶斯层间升级机制。
en_tdlr: This paper presents FRACTAL, a self-similar multi-agent architecture that recursively decomposes goals via a unified five-component pattern, with formal guarantees of linear communication cost, a two-mode orchestration criterion, supermajority convergence probability bounds, a depth bound, and a Bayesian inter-layer escalation mechanism.
